FR-001.title: Dedicated Record AGM entry point on the Events menu, separate from generic create-event flow

FR-002.title: AGM recorded as its own record type, not an entry in the general Events list

FR-003.title: Annual General Meeting removed as a selectable type for new generic events; historical events preserved

FR-004.title: AGM screen lists active members for attendance, with per-member and select-all marking

FR-005.title: AGM attendance grid has no page-number controls; grid scrolls independently of the page

FR-006.title: AGM screen assigns President/Secretary/Treasurer per year, vacant if unassigned

FR-007.title: AGM screen assigns members to additional office-holder positions or as general committee members

FR-008.title: A member cannot be assigned to more than one position or seat within the same AGM

FR-009.title: Saving an AGM persists meeting, attendance, and committee positions atomically

FR-010.title: Saving AGM election results supersedes existing committee position records for that year

FR-011.title: Saved AGM attendance and election results are read-only; corrections via a superseding AGM

FR-012.title: Coordinator can add, rename, reorder, and archive custom office-holder position titles

FR-013.title: Built-in President/Secretary/Treasurer positions cannot be renamed, reordered, or archived

FR-016.title: Coordinator can open a past AGM to view attendance and elected positions read-only

FR-017.title: A past AGM record can be archived (soft-deleted) rather than permanently removed

FR-018.title: Annual committee-reset reminder banner updated to trigger off the new AGM record, not a generic event

FR-019.title: Automated tests cover every reachable code path introduced by this feature

FR-014.title: Coordinator sets a target general-committee-seat count; AGM screen shows seats filled vs target

FR-015.title: Browsable list of past AGMs, most-recent-first, showing date and attendance count

FR-020.title: Setup wizard includes a step for committee office-holder titles and general committee seat count

FR-021.title: Committee configuration during setup is optional; can be completed later from Settings

FR-022.title: Setup wizard lets coordinator select the calendar month the AGM is normally held

FR-023.title: Committee term runs from the AGM date to the next AGM date, not a fixed calendar year

FR-024.title: Committee term labeled with the calendar year containing the majority of its days

FR-025.title: Saving a new AGM supersedes committee position records for the term it starts, not a calendar year

FR-026.title: Coordinator can record a special/interim election to replace a departing committee member or office holder

FR-027.title: Special election closes departing holder's record with an end date and creates a new record for the incoming member

FR-028.title: More than one committee position record can exist for the same position within the same term

FR-029.title: Multiple holders in one term's position are shown/printed with each holder's service start/end dates

FR-030.title: AGM month setting is the single source of truth for both the reset reminder and committee term boundaries

issue: #292 separate committee service years from calendar years

intent: Let a coordinator record an AGM's attendance and committee elections (office holders + general committee members) in one workflow, as its own record type separate from generic Events.
expectations: No new AGM outcome types beyond attendance, office-holder elections, and general-committee elections in this release
No hard cap enforced on the general-committee seat count target — it is guidance only
No in-place editing of a saved AGM's attendance/election data — corrections are a new superseding AGM
No retroactive re-dating of committee position records created before AGM-to-AGM term tracking existed
approach: Replace Event-based AGM recording with a dedicated AnnualGeneralMeeting/AgmAttendanceRecord entity pair saved atomically alongside CommitteeOfficeHolderType/CommitteeTerm/CommitteePositionRecord (renamed+extended CommitteeMembership); each AGM save auto-closes the prior open term and opens a new one, which is also what makes the old manual reset banner obsolete and removable.

decisions.decision: Committee terms auto-supersede via chronological open/close (each AGM save closes the prior open CommitteeTerm and opens a new one)
decisions.why: Mechanically satisfies the clarified same-term-rerun edge case without any bespoke supersede/delete operation - current committee is just whichever term has EndDate == null
decisions.rejected: Explicit rewrite/soft-delete of the prior AGMs position records tied to one shared term row

decisions.decision: Rename CommitteeMembership to CommitteePositionRecord in place, adding nullable CommitteeTermId/OfficeHolderTypeId/StartDate/EndDate alongside the existing legacy Year/Position fields
decisions.why: Spec calls this entity existing-reused-extended and explicitly forbids retroactively re-dating historical calendar-year records
decisions.rejected: Synthesizing a CommitteeTerm per historical Year value and backfilling all legacy rows

decisions.decision: Delete CommitteeAnnualResetService/ICommitteeAnnualResetService entirely, including the Settings banner UI, LastCommitteeResetYear field, and the V13 integration test
decisions.why: Atomic AGM-save (FR-009/FR-010) already does everything the manual reset button used to do; clarified Q1 chose full replacement over keeping both
decisions.rejected: Repointing the banner at the new AnnualGeneralMeeting entity while keeping the manual reset action

decisions.decision: Build the new Committee Settings tab as a 5th hardcoded core tab in SettingsPage.razor (OnClick/Shown-flag pattern), not via ISettingsTabProvider
decisions.why: Research found ISettingsTabProvider is only actually used for plugin tabs and only gets the flakier OnShown wiring; the 4 real core tabs bypass it entirely with an OnClick fix for MAUI WebView concurrency issues
decisions.rejected: Registering as a genuine ISettingsTabProvider plugin, which would reintroduce the documented Bootstrap/concurrent-DbContext gotcha

decisions.decision: Model a special election as a service operation (close outgoing CommitteePositionRecord, open incoming one) rather than a new stored entity
decisions.why: Spec Key Entities lists exactly 5 entities with no Special Election entity, and everything FR-026/027/028 need is expressible as start/end dates on CommitteePositionRecord rows
decisions.rejected: A dedicated SpecialElection entity tracking outgoing/incoming member and replacement date as its own row

decisions.decision: Drop Annual General Meeting from EventTypeService default seed list (fresh installs never get the row) and rewrite DebugDataSeeder.SeedAgmAsync/SeedCommitteeAsync against the new AgmService/office-holder-type model rather than preserving them
decisions.why: User confirmed the seeded EventType row and dev/test fixture data are not real customer history - FR-003s preserve-existing-events requirement only matters for a genuine upgrading production install
decisions.rejected: Migrating/preserving the current seed datas old Event+EventType-shaped AGM records

plan.summary: Full plan produced: research.md (12 decisions), data-model.md (4 new + 1 extended entity, 2 removed services), contracts/agm-workflow-contract.md (routes, menu, service signatures), plan.md (Summary/Structure/Constitution Check, all PASS)
plan.key_finding: Saving a new AGM auto-closes the previously-open CommitteeTerm and opens a new one - this single mechanism is what makes the old manual reset banner obsolete, resolves the same-term-rerun edge case with no bespoke supersede logic, and is why FR-018s removal and FR-030s AGM-month reuse are safe independent changes
